items.title: 89:08 · Across the book s 1450-to-2026 dataset the
items.detail: Across the book's 1450-to-2026 dataset, the theorem claims that no non-kinetic reform permanently reduced the Elite's extraction share at the system apex.

items.title: 89:17 · That claim carries three simultaneous falsification conditions
items.detail: That claim carries three simultaneous falsification conditions.

items.title: 89:28 · Second aggregate apex extraction must decline in
items.detail: Second, aggregate apex extraction must decline in real terms across all channels, including offshore capital, newly targeted populations, and substitutions between labor and financial extraction.

items.title: 89:38 · Third the reduction must survive later periods
items.detail: Third, the reduction must survive later periods of low kinetic threat, demonstrating a durable alteration of the extraction kernel after the pressure that produced the reform recedes.

items.title: 89:49 · A reform satisfying all three conditions would
items.detail: A reform satisfying all three conditions would falsify the theorem regardless of the threat environment present when that reform was adopted.
